stem: A room total declines while one previously clean zone develops repeated positives. What should follow-up prioritize?
choices: Declare full control because the room total declined.
Remove the new-zone data as inconsistent.
Stop scouting until the next scheduled month.
Report overall decline and the new spatial expansion, with targeted follow-up of the newly affected zone.
rationale: Report overall decline and the new spatial expansion, with targeted follow-up of the newly affected zone.
